# P1.19 — Notifications (in-app), Inbox, phone-width web

Spec: `docs/tickets/47_P1.19__notifications-inbox-phone-width.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.19.md`
**Stage A only** — code + deterministic tests at $0. Stage B (dev deploy + the live in-app
notification legs ≤$10; the ~375 px device smoke) is operator-gated → `D-P1.19-1` / `D-P1.19-2`.
The merge is **operator-held**.

Stacks on `stevevitali/p1-18-export` (P1.18).

## Summary

The in-app half of the §5.11 matrix lands on PRB.09's existing event stream and server-side
prefs — not a parallel system: one `notify` event writes the Inbox row and the mail leg from
the same job, and one `notification_prefs` blob (now carrying `inApp`/`digest`/`project`
scopes) governs every channel, readable by web today and the 1.x app tomorrow (REQ-MOBILE-19).
`/app/inbox` is the global attention list with the spec's ONE ordering (blocked-on-you by
soonest deadline → unread events → read events → stale voices) and ONE badge rule (approvals +
decisions only). Below ~768 px every IDE route renders the reader-only Page plus the §10.1
input set — gate Approve/Wait-for-me/Stop with estimate, the five dispositions with a note,
text-only chat — and nothing from the ✗ column. The deferred email rows (voice-stale weekly
digest, day-12 trial, payment-failed, optional hourly run digest, product updates) ship behind
three cron sweeps. Email actions stay Wait-for-me/Open — never Approve.

## What changed

- **Contracts** (`packages/contracts/src/notifications.ts`): five new event types
  (`run_cancelled_recovered` — in-app only, email is failed-only; `voice_stale`; `chat_reply`;
  `run_progress` — per-project Advanced opt-in; `product_update` — email-only, off by default);
  `NOTIFICATION_MATRIX` declares each row's `inApp`/`push`/`email`/`defaultOn`/`configurable`/
  `osLevelOnlyWhenUnfocused`/`quietHoursDeferrable`/`collapse`; `EMAIL_EVENT_TYPES` is the
  email-capable subset (module-level self-check pins template coverage); `QUIET_HOURS_DEFERRABLE`
  = `{run_finished, chat_reply}`; prefs schema gains `inApp`/`digest`/`project` scopes; new
  templates for the voice digest, chat reply, product updates, and the hourly run digest;
  `emailEnabled` now honors `email:"opt_in"` (a stored pref can turn it on — `defaultOn`
  describes the in-app arm, so chat's mail no longer defaults on).
- **DB** — migration `0039_in_app_notifications.sql`: `inbox_items` gains `collapse_key`,
  `run_id`, `visible_at` + the per-user collapse index; Drizzle parity.
- **findings-core** — `inbox.ts`: `inboxOrder`/`inboxBlockedOrder`/`inboxBadgeCount`/
  `inboxGroups`, the shared pure ordering + badge rule.
- **orchestrator** — `inbox.ts`: tenant-tx `listInbox`/`readInboxBadge`/read receipts (blocked
  rows = open unheld gates on waiting runs + open `decision_requests`; quiet-deferred rows hide
  until `visible_at`; stale voices derive read-time via the moved `voice-status.ts` assembler —
  relocated verbatim from `apps/api` so the worker sweep shares it). `notifications.ts`:
  `deliverInApp` collapse-upsert, `runLandingPath` (workflow → canonical §4.2 landing),
  `scheduleRunProgressNotification` (project opt-in only), sweep handlers (`voice_digest`,
  `trial_ending`/payment-failed, `run_digest`, `product_update`); gate-expiry rides the same
  seam (system cancel → `run_cancelled_recovered` in-app; `completed_partial` mails nothing).
  `email-actions.ts`: deep links now carry the project **slug**; `billingDeepLink` →
  `/settings/billing`.
- **obligations** — a horizon-arrived deferral opens a `decision_requests` row
  ("decide / re-defer / drop", idempotent); `escalateStalls` fires for hand-run rounds (§6.8).
- **api** — `GET /inbox`, `GET /inbox/badge`, `POST /inbox/read{,-run,-all}`; prefs PUT accepts
  the new scopes and still 400s on the two non-configurable rows; a decision row carrying an
  obligation resolves re-defer/drop through the real P0.12 transitions.
- **worker** — `notify.sweep.weekly` (voice digest, Mon 04:45 UTC), `notify.sweep.daily`
  (day-12 trial + payment-failed, 04:50), `notify.sweep.hourly` (run digest, :55) — each fans
  out singleton-keyed per-workspace `notify` jobs; idempotent on redelivery.
- **web** — `/app/inbox` + `InboxPage` (api's own order in named sections; a gate row's
  `<details>` expand is the MVP side-sheet mounting the real `GateCard` — the artifact read
  precedes the Approve; read receipts; `?gate=<id>` mounts the focused card on the dossier —
  also the phone approve surface). REQ-IDE-48: a project with an unread finished run lands on
  the walkthrough card (collapsed row marks read on open). Phone width: `isPhoneRequest` →
  `compact` on every `PageData` via `ideContext`; generated CSS emits the §5.1 ladder
  (Margin→ticks <1280, single-column + bottom-sheet Timeline <1024, reader Page <768); compact
  suppresses run-start/config, ingestion, diffs, billing, export, new-project, bulk
  accept/apply, approval-field editing, voice building — and keeps the §10.1 input set (focused
  gate card + estimate, five dispositions + note, compact text-only `ChatDesk` inside the Page,
  read-only `PageSurface`/`VersionRail`). No app-banner markup exists at MVP.

## Non-goals (ticket's own Out of scope)

Push + native app (1.x — the `NotificationTransport` seam is named); approval-field editing and
"run next with defaults" on phone (1.1); the Settings → Notifications page (P1.20 owns the
surface — this ticket owns the matrix + prefs it edits). Any merge — `mergePolicy: OPERATOR`.

## Verification

- `pnpm turbo build lint typecheck` — **129/129 green**.
- `pnpm test` — **3,285 pass / 3 skip / 360 files**. The only failures en route were four
  pre-P1.19 contract expectations (email-template coverage over in-app-only rows, the
  run_finished-only quiet set, default-ON over opt-in rows) — resolved at the contract, never
  by weakening non-configurable enforcement.
- `pnpm check:licenses` — 607 packages OK. `pnpm check:protocol-markers` — 45 files clean.
- Deterministic legs: matrix fixtures per event row (contracts 11); notify lifecycle incl.
  quiet-hours, collapse, cancelled→in-app-only (orchestrator 8); inbox/badge/read receipts +
  non-configurable 400 + signed-action security (api 10); the phone-width layout seam
  (`inbox-phone.test.ts` 12); ordering + badge fixtures (findings-core).
